app.description: متن الشاطبية — حِرز الأماني ووجه التهاني: synced audio recitation over the scanned manuscript pages of the Shatibiyyah poem (1173 verses, 79 chapters).
app.origin: Port of an earlier PWA (js/audio.js, page-viewer.js, sync.js, data.js, verse-text.js, app.js, style.css).

layouts.desktop: width >= 1025: side controls panel on the right plus the page viewer
layouts.mobile: width < 1025: full-screen page viewer with immersive chrome that slides away, plus bottom sheets and overlays

architecture.pattern: Plain ChangeNotifier controllers wired by broadcast streams; no state-management package used.

modules.name: AppController
modules.role: Orchestrator. Wires engine, viewer, and sync events into UI state. Owns the bar state machine, sheets, session chip, chapter progress, immersive auto-hide, and search.

modules.name: AudioEngine
modules.role: Owns the just_audio player and all playback state: modes, repeats, pause, speed, boundaries, seeking. Knows nothing about pages.

modules.name: PageViewerController + PageViewer
modules.role: Page image, highlight overlay painter, zoom/pan transform, raw-pointer gesture engine, view prefs (night, brightness, boxes).

modules.name: SyncController
modules.role: The only module that touches both audio and viewer. Keeps the page following playback, routes verse taps to audio, owns the 'detached' browsing state.

modules.name: ShatibiyyahData
modules.role: Loads verses/timestamps/chapters JSON and builds lookups: verseMap, pageMap, verseTimes, chapterPageRange, chaptersByPage, startAtVerse.

modules.name: VerseTextData
modules.role: Parses shatibiyyah.txt into verse lines (sadr/ajuz) and builds the diacritic-insensitive search index.

modules.name: Prefs
modules.role: SharedPreferences wrapper with a synchronous getLS/setLS API that mirrors localStorage. All values stored as strings.

features.name: Boot sequence and splash screen
features.description: Loads prefs, data JSON, and verse text, builds all controllers, and shows the cover image on paper background for at least 1200 ms, then fades out over 400 ms.
details: JustAudioBackground.init runs first. A failure there is swallowed so the in-app player still works.
If verse text fails to load, it falls back to an empty VerseTextData, so search and the session-chip text are empty but the app runs.
If data loading fails, it shows the error screen 'تعذّر تحميل البيانات'.
HomeScreen stays at a stable tree position under the splash so boot() and the audio load never run twice.
boot() is guarded by _booted. It loads the audio source, re-applies the mode, highlights the current verse, sets the bar to idle, and shows the session chip.

features.name: Transport controls: play/pause, stop, previous, next

ui.full_transport: Row of prev · play/pause · stop · next (LTR). Play is a gold-filled circle; the others are outlined gold rings. Scale to 0.9 on press. Shown in the console block.
ui.mini_transport: Mobile mini bar: the same four buttons, smaller. Shown only when barState is playing or paused. In idle state a single ▶ button is shown instead.

behavior.togglePlay: If paused and the position is at or past the range end (minus eps) or more than 0.5 s before the range start, restart from the range start. Otherwise resume. If playing, pause.
behavior.stop: Pause, cancel any pending inter-verse pause, reset verse and section repeat counters, seek to the range start, set the bar to idle.
behavior.prev_next: seekToVerse(current ± 1), clamped to the current range. Keeps playing if it was playing.

features.name: Playback modes: باب (chapter) / نطاق (custom range) / كل المتن (full poem)

modes.chapter: Plays one chapter from its start_time to the next chapter's start_time. The end verse is the next chapter's start_verse - 1, or 1173 for the last chapter.
modes.range: Plays from fromVerse to toVerse. The end time is the next verse's start, cut earlier at the next chapter header's start_time when a chapter starts right after.
modes.full: Plays verses 1 to 1173 over the whole audio duration.

details: Switching mode pauses audio, cancels the pending pause timer, and calls setupRange(false), which resets the position to the range start.
Mode, chapter index, and from/to are persisted.
An invalid persisted mode falls back to 'chapter'.

features.name: Verse repeat (تكرار البيت)
features.behavior: At each verse boundary, if verseRepsLeft > 1, decrement it, announce the verse with a pulse, and seek back to the verse start. Otherwise reset the counter and advance.

features.name: Section/range repeat (تكرار المقطع)
features.behavior: At the range end (reachRangeEnd, guarded by atEndGuard), decrement sectionRepsLeft unless it is ∞. If reps remain, jump to the range start and keep playing. Otherwise pause, park at the range start, and emit 'ended', which sets the bar to idle.

features.name: Pause between verses (فاصل زمني)
features.behavior: When advancing to the next verse with pauseSeconds > 0, pause the player and resume from the new verse start after N seconds. A playToken invalidates the timer if the user seeks, stops, or changes mode meanwhile.

features.name: Recitation speed (سرعة التلاوة)
features.behavior: Applied through player.setSpeed on every play and on change. The boundary lead eps = max(0.14 s, speed × 0.16) widens at higher speeds so the next verse doesn't bleed in.

features.name: Verse boundary detection and position tracking
details: tick() runs on every positionStream event and on a 16 ms Timer.periodic while playing (the analogue of the PWA's timeupdate + rAF pump).
Effective verse end = min(next verse start, range end). A boundary fires at effEnd - eps.
verseFromTime uses binary search over verseTimes, bounded to the current range.
Every seek is re-checked after 450 ms and retried once if the position is more than 0.5 s off.
Duration = max(the player's reported duration, last verse timestamp + 1). The default is 8916 s.
Natural completion of the file (ProcessingState.completed) calls reachRangeEnd().
Seeks requested before the source is ready are queued in pendingSeek and applied in onLoaded().

features.name: Range scrubber with live verse preview

variants.full: Console block. Slider plus elapsed/total time labels (Arabic-Indic m:ss, relative to the range start), LTR.
variants.mini: Mobile mini bar seek row. Thinner, no labels. Shown when playing or paused.

features.behavior: The slider spans the current range, not the whole file. Dragging sets scrubbing = true and calls previewVerseAt(frac), which updates the current verse and highlight live. Release calls seekToFraction(frac), which resets verse repeats and keeps the play state.
features.perf_note: Time updates go through a separate ValueNotifier (AppController.time) so they don't trigger full notifyListeners rebuilds.

features.name: Background playback / lock-screen media controls
details: just_audio_background with MediaItem: title 'متن الشاطبية', artist 'الشيخ محمد عتيق', album 'متن الشاطبية · الشيخ محمد عتيق'.
Android: WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permissions, the AudioService foreground service (mediaPlayback), and an ongoing notification.
iOS: Info.plist has no UIBackgroundModes 'audio' entry. See known_gaps.

features.name: Fully offline bundled audio
features.details: assets/audio/audio.mp3 (~71 MB, CBR 64k mono) is loaded with AudioSource.asset, so there is no network dependency. The PWA's offline download/caching logic was dropped.

features.name: Scanned manuscript page viewer
details: 94 pages (assets/pages/page001–094.webp, native size 1130×1735). The page is fitted to the viewport width (baseScale = width / 1130).
View transform {zoom, tx, ty} is applied through a Matrix4 to the image and overlay together. Pan is clamped, and the page is centered when smaller than the viewport.
Warm radial viewer background, page drop shadow, and page background #FBF7EE by day or #140D05 at night.
gaplessPlayback avoids a flash on page change.

features.name: Active verse highlight with crossfade and pulse
details: The current verse's bounding box is painted as a rounded rect (radius 9, fill plus 2 px stroke). Day palette is amber, night palette is blue-violet.
Moving between verses crossfades the old box out and the new box in over 200 ms.
Pulse: an expanding, fading ring (460 ms) on verse tap, search jump, chapter jump, and repeat restarts.
The overlay ticker runs only while an animation is active.

features.name: Auto page-turn and follow playback
details: On a verse change while attached: if the verse is on another page, load that page and reset the view. If zoomed in, do a 'cinematic turn' instead: zoom out, wait 400 ms, then zoom to 1.5× centered on the new verse (360 ms).
On the same page, re-center only when zoomed or scrollable and the box is outside the middle 60% of the viewport (the 'respectVisible' comfort zone).

features.name: Show all verse boxes toggle
features.details: When on, draws a faint ghost outline around every verse on the page except the active one. Toolbar button 'إظهار صناديق الأبيات'.

features.name: Night mode with brightness slider
details: Recolors the page with a combined color matrix equal to CSS invert(1) sepia(.3) brightness(b).
A brightness slider (50–110%, default 85) appears in the toolbar only while night mode is on.
Highlight colors switch to the night palette, and the mobile page indicator color adapts.

features.name: Pinch-zoom, double-tap zoom, pan with momentum
details: A custom gesture engine on raw pointer events (Listener), not Flutter's gesture arena.
Pinch: zoom 1×–4× anchored at the finger centroid. Releasing below 1.02× snaps back to 1×.
Double-tap (within 300 ms and 34 px): if zoomed, reset. Otherwise zoom to 2.4× centered on the tapped verse, or on the tap point if no verse was hit.
Pan when zoomed or vertically scrollable, with momentum (0.94 friction per frame) on release.
Tap slop is 10 px, and a tap must finish within 500 ms.
Desktop-only zoom toggle button: resets if zoomed, otherwise zooms to 2.2× on the active verse.
Honors the OS reduce-motion setting (MediaQuery.disableAnimations): no animated transforms, no momentum, no pulse or crossfade.

features.name: Manual page navigation
details: Swipe: a horizontal swipe of more than 55 px that is mostly horizontal turns the page. Swiping right goes to the next page (RTL book).
Desktop: › and ‹ arrow buttons on the viewer edges.
A manual page change resets zoom and puts sync into the 'detached' state (see resume-chip).

features.name: Page number indicator
features.details: Shows 'n / 94' in Arabic-Indic digits. Desktop: a pill at the bottom of the viewer. Mobile: a faint label shown only while the chrome is hidden, at 12% opacity, flashing to 70% for 1.8 s on page change.

mobile_only: Search (بحث في الأبيات), opens the full-screen search overlay
conditional: Brightness slider when night mode is on

features.name: Tap a verse on the page to jump audio there
details: Hit test: a direct hit inside a verse box, or else the nearest verse center within 1.2× the box height.
The tap pulses the verse, switches to باب mode for the chapter that owns the verse (if not already there), and seeks to the verse, keeping the play/pause state.
It also silently seeds the نطاق range with from = to = the tapped verse (presetRange) without switching mode.
It clears any chapter-header selection and re-attaches sync.

features.name: Detached browsing and the 'return to verse' chip
details: A manual page turn detaches: playback continues, but the viewer stops following it.
A floating gold chip 'عودة إلى البيت N' (mobile: bottom-center above the chrome) re-attaches and jumps the view to the playing verse.
Pressing Play while detached re-attaches automatically.
Selecting a chapter from the list also re-attaches.

features.name: Chapter list (اختر الباب)
row_contents: 'الأبيات a–b · n بيت · ص pages' meta line
features.behavior: Tapping a row sets باب mode on that chapter (pausing and resetting to its start), re-attaches sync, and closes the range sheet. The active chapter is highlighted in gold.
features.placement: Desktop: inside the side panel, max height 440. Mobile: inside the range sheet, filling the height with sticky tabs.

features.name: Tappable chapter headers on the page + 'تشغيل الباب' band
details: All 79 chapters have header bounding boxes. Tapping one selects it and draws a gold 3 px outline on the header.
The chapter-action band shows the name and 'n بيت · الأبيات a–b' with a 'تشغيل الباب' button. The button is disabled at 50% opacity if the chapter has no start_time.
Play Chapter sets the chapter, seeks to its start_time, highlights, and starts playing.
Tapping empty page space or a verse clears the selection. On mobile, selecting a header also reveals the hidden chrome.
Desktop: the band sits at the top of the side panel. Mobile: it sits above the range-status card.

features.name: Custom verse range (نطاق) steppers
details: Two steppers, 'من البيت' and 'إلى البيت', each with −/+ buttons and a numeric text field.
The field accepts Western, Arabic-Indic, or Persian digits (normDigits). It commits on submit or on tap-outside.
Validation: both values are clamped to 1–1173, and to is forced ≥ from. Any change switches to نطاق mode and resets playback to the range start.
Helper text: 'اختر بيتًا بين ١ و ١١٧٣'.

features.name: كل المتن info panel
features.details: Static card: 'المتن كاملًا — من البيت ١ إلى البيت ١١٧٣'.

features.name: Unified chapter + verse search
matching: Diacritic-insensitive: strips tashkeel U+0610–061A and U+064B–065F, superscript alef U+0670, and tatweel U+0640.
Folds آ أ إ ٱ to ا. Alef maqsura ى is not folded.
Substring match on chapter names and on the full verse text.
results: Group 'الأبواب' (matching chapters, sorted by start verse) comes first, then 'الأبيات' (verses, capped at 30).
A verse row shows the verse number, chapter name, 'صـ page', and the sadr with the match highlighted. The highlight maps back through the normalization and extends over trailing diacritics.
An empty result shows 'لا توجد نتائج'.

actions.pick_verse: jumpToVerse(id, play: false): switches to the owning chapter if the verse is out of range, seeks, pauses, pulses, and re-attaches.
actions.pick_chapter: Selects the chapter header, navigates to its page, centers the header, pulses the first verse, and shows the 'تشغيل الباب' band.

ui.desktop: Inline search bar in the side panel with results below (max height 400). Picking a result clears the query.
ui.mobile: Full-screen overlay opened from the toolbar search button, with an auto-focused field and a ✕ close button. Closing clears the query.

features.name: Resume last session chip (استكمال التلاوة)
details: Once playback has happened, the session is saved on pause and 2 s (debounced) after each verse change: verseId, chapterId, chapterName, the first 8 words of the sadr, and pageNum.
On launch, if a session exists, a chip at the top of the console shows 'البيت N · chapter' plus the verse snippet.
Tapping the chip jumps to that verse and plays. The × button dismisses it.
The chip also hides automatically on the first play.

features.name: Per-chapter listening progress
features.details: On every verse change, progress = (verse - start) / (end - start) for the active chapter (or the chapter owning the verse in other modes). It only ever increases, and reaching the end verse sets it to 1. Saved 800 ms after the last change (debounced) and shown as bars and done-dots in the chapter list.

features.name: Immersive full-screen reading (mobile)
details: Starts with the chrome hidden on mobile unless 'keep controls visible' is on.
Tapping empty page space toggles the chrome. If a chapter header is selected, the tap clears it instead.
The top toolbar slides up and the bottom chrome slides down (300 ms). The page viewer expands to full height.
Auto-hide delay: 3 s while playing, 9 s when paused mid-range, 3 s when idle at 0, and 5 s after a control interaction.
Auto-hide is postponed while any panel is open (console, range sheet, search, or chapter selection).
Auto-hide is rescheduled on play, pause, and closing a sheet.

features.name: Keep controls visible toggle (إبقاء عناصر التحكم ظاهرة)
features.details: Custom pill switch at the bottom of the mobile console sheet. When on, auto-hide is disabled and the chrome is shown.

features.name: Range status card
features.details: Bottom card showing the mode icon (📖 / 🎯 / 📚), a title (chapter name / 'نطاق مخصص' / 'كل المتن'), a subtitle with the verse span, and ▼. Tapping it opens the range selector sheet.

features.name: 3-state mini audio bar

states.playing / paused: Verse info · mini transport · gear, plus a seek row below

features.details: Tapping the bar or the gear toggles the console sheet. After a pause, the bar state becomes 'idle' if the position is within 0.4 s of the range start, otherwise 'paused'. The 'ended' event sets it to idle.

features.name: Console bottom sheet (mobile)
features.details: 62% of screen height, with a dark backdrop. Close by tapping the backdrop or dragging the grip more than 80 px. Contents: session chip, console block (compact medallion row, scrubber, transport), the 2×2 control cards, and the keep-controls toggle.

features.name: Range selector bottom sheet (mobile)
features.details: 70% of screen height, with sticky mode tabs over the scrolling chapter list (or the range steppers or full-poem panel). Drag to dismiss (more than 80 px) or tap the backdrop. Picking a chapter closes it.

features.name: Desktop side controls panel
features.details: Width is 34% of the screen, clamped to 320–430 px, on the right in RTL. Contents in order: chapter-action band, brand header ('الشاطبية' / 'حِرْزُ الأماني · بصوت الشيخ محمد عتيق'), ornament divider, session chip, mode tabs plus active panel, inline search, console block (large medallion), and control cards. The viewer has nav arrows, the toolbar with zoom, and the page pill.

features.name: Now-playing medallion (shamsa)
details: A custom-painted 16-point star shamsa with concentric rings. It shows the current verse number in Arabic-Indic digits.
An outer ring of 8 dots spins (one turn per 44 s) while playing and stops on pause.
The glow is at 70% opacity while playing and 25% otherwise. The number pops to 1.08× on each verse change (not while scrubbing).
Desktop: 150 px medallion over the caption 'البيت' and the chapter name. Mobile: 62 px medallion beside the chapter name (2 lines max).

features.name: Advanced control cards + picker sheet
features.details: Each card shows its current value. Tapping a card opens a picker bottom sheet (blurred backdrop, 340 ms slide, drag handle to dismiss) with chips for the option set. The selected chip is gold. Picking a value applies it immediately and closes the sheet after 130 ms.

features.name: Arabic-first localization
details: The only locale is ar, with global Material, Widgets, and Cupertino delegates. The whole app is wrapped in RTL Directionality.
Every number is shown in Arabic-Indic digits with the ٫ decimal separator (ar()). Times use m:ss format (fmtTime()).
The transport and scrubber are explicitly LTR.
Fonts: Scheherazade New (naskh: verse text, names, numbers) and Reem Kufi (kufi: brand, tabs, labels, sheet titles).

features.name: Warm dark gold theme
features.details: Material 3 dark theme with design tokens ported 1:1 from the PWA CSS: espresso surfaces (ink #1B1307 → raised #3F2F15), gold accents (#FFAB2E / #FADBAE / #965F0D), and cream text. Radii are 22/16/12, the tap target is 52. Splash and highlight ripples are disabled. The system status and navigation bars are styled dark.

features.name: Verse action menu (long-press a verse)

evidence: res/layout/arc_menu.xml (arc of FABs: تشغيل, مشاركة, نسخ, اختبار الحفظ, اضافة ملاحظة, التفسير/الترجمة, bookmark, close)
res/layout/arc_menu_quran_text.xml (same menu in the text view, without the test)
intro slide 2: 'قائمه التحكم في الايات قم بفتحها بالضغط المطول على الايه'
mushaf_reference.behavior: Long-pressing an ayah opens a radial menu anchored on it.

features.adaptation: Long-press a verse box on the manuscript page (or a verse row in text mode) to open a menu for that verse. A single tap keeps today's behavior (verse-tap-to-seek).
requirements: Actions: تشغيل من هنا · الشرح · نص البيت/نسخ · مشاركة · إضافة مرجع · إضافة ملاحظة · اختبار الحفظ · بداية/نهاية النطاق · حالة الحفظ.
The menu is anchored to the verse rectangle and stays on screen at any zoom level. It is dismissed by a tap outside or Back.
The long-press threshold (≈450 ms) must not conflict with the custom gesture engine. Long-press is a new pointer state in PageViewerController, cancelled by any movement beyond the tap slop.
Haptic feedback on open. Every action has a semantics label.

features.name: Multi-verse selection across pages

evidence: questions_array/answers_array[5]: long-press the first verse, then tap the last one on the same page or a later page. Double-tap anywhere cancels.
share_list: 'صوره من الآيات المحددة' / 'نص من الآيات المحددة'
mushaf_reference.behavior: Selects a contiguous run of ayahs, even across pages. The selection feeds share, copy and play.

features.adaptation: Select verses a–b directly on the scan or in text mode. The selection becomes the نطاق range (playback), the share or copy source, and a scope for memorization tests. This replaces typing numbers into the steppers.
requirements: Start with a long-press, or with 'بداية النطاق' from the verse action menu. Extend by tapping the end verse, on the same or a later page. Selection is RTL-aware and allowed backwards (normalized to from ≤ to).
Selected verses are painted with a distinct selection color, different from the active-playback highlight and the chapter-header selection.
A contextual bar shows 'n أبيات محددة (a–b)' with actions: تشغيل النطاق · تكرار · نسخ · مشاركة · اختبار · إضافة مرجع. Double-tap on empty space or ✕ cancels.
Turning the page during selection doesn't cancel it. The bar stays visible.

features.name: Share and copy verses (text, cropped image, page image)

evidence: array/share_list: صوره من الآيات المحددة · نص من الآيات المحددة · صوره لكامل الصفحة
string/share_pages_limit 'لا يمكن مشاركة اكثر من 3 صفحات'
menu/search_menu.xml and menu/tafsir_menu.xml (copy/share of results and tafsir)
mushaf_reference.behavior: Share the selected ayahs as text or as an image cropped from the printed page, or share the whole page image. Copy the text. Sharing is limited to 3 pages.

features.adaptation: Share one verse or a selected range as vocalized text, or as an image cropped from the manuscript using verse_regions rectangles. Also: the whole page, or a styled text card. Every share includes an attribution line.
requirements: Text format: 'البيت N — chapter\nsadr\najuz' per verse, then '— متن الشاطبية (تيسير الشاطبية)'. Numbers use Arabic-Indic digits.

Image crop: union of the selected verses' rectangles on each page, with padding, rendered from the page WebP. Multiple pages are stacked. Limit: 3 pages. Night mode is not applied, so the scan's original colors are shared.
Styled card: verse text in Scheherazade New on a paper background, plus verse number and chapter name.
Copy to clipboard shows the confirmation 'تم النسخ'.
Uses the platform share sheet (share_plus). Temporary images go to the cache directory.

features.name: Page and verse bookmarks (المرجعيات) with color, tag and note

evidence: bookmark_item.xml / bookmark_header_item.xml (sections مرجعيات الآيات / مرجعيات الصفحات / آخر المتصفحات)
answers_array[7]: drag the top ribbon onto a page or an ayah; dragging it again moves the bookmark
mushaf_reference.behavior: Drag a ribbon handle onto a page or ayah to bookmark it. Bookmarks have a color, a tag and a note, and can be moved by dragging again. The list is grouped into verse bookmarks, page bookmarks and recent pages.

features.adaptation: Bookmark a verse (stable verse ID) or a manuscript page. The ribbon handle works on the scan. A tag such as حفظ / مراجعة / إشكال lets students separate purposes.
requirements: Add from the verse action menu, by dragging the ribbon handle at the page edge, or from the commentary reader (bookmark an explanation).
Fields: target (verse ID or page number), color (6-color palette), optional tag, optional note, created/updated timestamps.
Dragging an existing ribbon to another verse or page moves that bookmark ('تم تغيير الفاصل إلى البيت N'). Snackbar with Undo.
Markers: a small colored ribbon at the corner of the verse rectangle on the scan and next to the verse number in text mode.
List screen grouped by type, with tag filter and sort by verse order or date. Swipe or menu to edit and delete.
Stored in user.sqlite by stable ID, never by list index. Included in backup-and-sync.
data: user.sqlite: bookmarks (DESIGN.md §3.4, extended with page_number, tag)

features.name: Personal notes on verses (الملاحظات)

evidence: quran_image_fragment.xml: a notes icon on the page
mushaf_reference.behavior: Attach a note to an ayah. A notes icon on the page opens that page's notes. There is a notes tab on the home screen, and each note can jump back to its ayah.

features.adaptation: Notes on a verse, or on a commentary explanation (for example a teacher's remark or a mnemonic for a رمز). They are reachable from the page, from the verse action menu, and from a Notes list.
requirements: Create or edit in a bottom sheet with a multiline RTL field. Title: 'ملاحظة على البيت N'.
A notes icon appears on pages or verse rows that have notes. Tapping it lists the notes for the current page.
Notes list: search, sort by verse or date, and 'تصفح البيت' jumps the reader to the verse.
Optional link to a commentary block (commentary_block_id), so the note opens next to that explanation.
Stored in user.sqlite. Included in backup-and-sync.

features.name: Automatic reading history and 'continue' card

evidence: pref key auto_last_bookmark 'عدد صفحات آخر المرجعيات التلقائية' (N recent pages saved automatically)
activity_main.xml last_read_lay: 'آخر المتصفحات' + sura + page + 'متابعة القراءة'
mushaf_reference.behavior: The last N visited pages are saved automatically. The home screen shows a continue-reading card.

features.adaptation: Keep the last N places the student visited, whether by reading or by listening, as verse and page entries. Extends session-resume, which today only restores the last playback verse.
requirements: Record a history entry when the user stays on a page for more than 3 s, or on playback pause. Consecutive entries on the same page are deduplicated.
Setting: history size (0 = off, default 10).
Shown in the bookmarks list under 'آخر المتصفحات' and as the continue card on home-screen.
Keyed by verse or page ID, and kept separate from session-resume's playback state.

features.name: Quick jump (الانتقال السريع) to page, verse, chapter or part

evidence: res/layout/went_dialog.xml (fields: صفحة, جزء, سورة + آية, حزب)
mushaf_reference.behavior: A dialog to jump to a page, juz, sura/ayah or hizb.

features.adaptation: Jump by page number (1–94), verse number (1–1173), chapter (picker of the 78 chapters) or part (مقدمة / الأصول / فرش الحروف / الخاتمة). This replaces juz and hizb.
requirements: Accepts Arabic-Indic, Persian and ASCII digits (reuse normDigits).

features.name: Verse text panel under the manuscript
features.rationale: The scans are hard to read on small screens, and the app never shows the playing verse's text (known_gaps: Current verse text). Mushaf has no equivalent, because its page image is the text.
requirements: Shows the vocalized sadr/ajuz of the active verse between the page and the bottom chrome. Collapsible. Can be shown in immersive mode.
Buttons: الشرح, ⋯ (verse action menu).

features.name: Compare the three commentaries side by side
features.rationale: Three complete commentaries are aligned to the same 1173 verses. Mushaf only switches between tafsirs one at a time.
requirements: Phone: swipe between books on the same verse. Tablet/desktop: 2–3 columns.

features.name: Search inside the commentaries
features.rationale: Mushaf searches only the Quran text. Students often look for a term, such as النقل or الإمالة, across the explanations.
requirements: A third result group 'في الشروح' with book filter chips. Snippets with highlighted matches. instr() over normalized segments and footnotes.

features.name: Spelling variants across editions (اختلاف النسخ)
features.rationale: shatibiyyah-data stores how each of the three editions prints every verse (3519 witness spellings).
requirements: The canonical verse, then each book's spelling, with word-level differences underlined and the similarity %.

features.name: Cross-references between verses in the commentaries
features.rationale: The data records 10 'quotes' and 4 'references' relations. This is the Shatibiyyah analogue of Mushaf's in-tafsir ayah links.
requirements: Footer in the commentary reader: 'ذُكر هذا البيت أيضًا في شرح البيت …'. Each entry is tappable.

features.name: Source, printed page and review status for each explanation
features.rationale: Every block has provenance (provider page, URL, printed page) and a review status. Showing it makes the app citable.
requirements: 'المصدر: قرآنبيديا ص … · الطبعة ص …' with a link to the reader page. An amber badge on the 6 needs_review blocks.

features.name: Play or skip the recited chapter titles
features.rationale: Both recordings have 77 reviewed spoken-title cues (chapter_announcements). Skipping them gives continuous verse drills. Playing them helps orientation.
requirements: Setting (default: play). While a title plays, the UI shows the chapter name instead of a verse number.

features.name: Guided memorization modes and spaced review
features.rationale: Beyond Mushaf's single test: تلقين (listen N times, then a silent gap to recite), ربط (chaining consecutive verses), and a spaced-repetition review queue driven by test grades.
requirements: Recite gap = verse window × factor (1.0–1.5).
SM-2-lite scheduler with daily limits. A memorized / learning / new bar per chapter.
A review session uses memorization-test for each due verse.

features.name: Listening and study statistics
features.rationale: Motivation and self-tracking. Mushaf only tracks khatma progress.
requirements: Daily minutes against a goal, a 7-day chart, a streak, and chapters completed per reciter.

features.name: Sleep timer
features.rationale: Long listening sessions (a chapter or the whole matn). No sleep timer was found in Mushaf's resources.
requirements: 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 min, or end of verse / chapter / range. Fade out over the last 5 s.

features.name: Visible repeat counters and pause countdown
features.rationale: verse-repeat and section-repeat run silently. Students drilling with ×5 or ∞ need to see where they are. Mushaf has no counter UI either (RepeatInfo is internal).
requirements: Chip 'البيت ٢/٥' on the medallion, a section-loop ring, and a countdown ring during inter-verse-pause.

features.name: Audio interruptions and verse-level lock-screen info
features.rationale: Today the MediaItem is static ('متن الشاطبية'), and call or headphone-unplug handling isn't wired (audio_session is a dependency, but unused for interruptions). Mushaf has notification controls (covered by background-audio), but verse-level metadata is the missing part.
requirements: Pause on calls and on becoming noisy. No auto-resume after a call.
Update MediaItem per verse: title = chapter, album = 'البيت N', artist = reciter. Lock-screen next/prev = verse.

known_gaps.issue: ios/Runner/Info.plist has no UIBackgroundModes → audio, so playback likely stops when the app is backgrounded or the screen locks on iOS, despite just_audio_background.

AppController has settingsOpen / openSettings / closeSettings, but no widget renders a settings sheet. The PWA had one with night, brightness, and page cache. Night and brightness live in the toolbar instead.
The K.immersiveHint key is defined, but no first-run hint is implemented.
AudioEngine emits onLoadError, but nothing listens, so a failed audio load gives the user no feedback. The 'offline' event named in the header comment does not exist.
chapterHover is never assigned, so the dashed hover outline painter never draws. It was a desktop mouse-hover feature in the PWA.
Verse text (sadr/ajuz) is loaded but only shown in search results and the session chip. There is no display of the text of the currently playing verse.
flutter_riverpod is declared but unused. xing-toc.json is bundled but unused.
App name differs per platform: Android 'تيسير الشاطبية', iOS 'Shatibiyyah', MaterialApp title 'الشاطبية — حِرز الأماني ووجه التهاني'.
main.dart locks portrait, but iOS Info.plist still lists landscape orientations for iPhone.
README.md is still the default Flutter template.

planned_architecture.summary: The missing/proposed features assume the V2 content database: a read-only content.sqlite (verses, chapters, layout regions, commentaries, recordings, timings), a writable user.sqlite for personal data, prefs v2 keyed by stable IDs, and on-demand audio downloads. None of it is implemented yet.
